title: 1.4S, 86.2W - Tumerok Towers
name: Tumerok Towers
desc:
=== Description === Two Tower with Tumeroks at 1.4S 86.2W in the Dires near Fort Tethana, close to the Obsidian Rim Portal.
It is one of the POIs incidated on the Ingame Map. See Points of Interest Map, no. 31.

title: 1.9N, 56.7W - Tumerok Outpost
name: Tumerok Outpost
desc:
=== Description === A Tumerok Outpost at 1.9N, 56.7W in the Dires near Fort Tethana.
The door to the outpost is locked (300 difficulty). Inside is four chests that spawn tier 3/4 Loot.

title: 10.3N, 68.8W - Tumerok Fort
name: Tumerok Fort
desc:
=== Description === A Tumerok Fort at 10.3N, 68.8W in the Dires near Fort Tethana.
It is one of the POIs incidated on the Ingame Map. See Points of Interest Map, no. 30.

title: 10.4N, 53.5E - Rithwic Festival Grounds
name: Rithwic Festival Grounds
desc:
=== Description === One of the Festival Grounds, this one located at 10.4N, 53.5E just a bit W from Rithwic.
It has two shopkeepers located in tents, two Chessboards, a running track, a few Target Drudges to practice on, and many more items to have a day out in the fields.

title: 11.3S, 37.6E - Empyrean Ruins
name: Empyrean Ruins
desc:
=== Description === A large Empyrean Ruins Site at 11.3S, 37.6E west of Yanshi with different portals and dungeons.
It consists of three Empyrean Three-legged Archs with portals, an Empyrean Platform with the portal to the Abandoned Arena, quite a few Empyrean Statues and the portal to the Colosseum

title: 12.3N, 73.7W - Tumerok Fort
name: Tumerok Fort
desc:
=== Description === A Tumerok Fort at 12.3N, 73.7W in the Dires near Fort Tethana.
This is the final fort in the Overlord's Sword Quest and the location of the dungeon where the Overlord himself is found. It is one of the POIs indicated on the Ingame Map. See Points of Interest Map, no. 29

title: 12.8S, 42.8E - Yanshi Festival Grounds
name: Yanshi Festival Grounds
desc:
=== Description === One of the Festival Grounds, this one located at 12.8S, 42.8E just a left of the drop to Yanshi.
It has a Farmer located in a tent, Chessboards, a few Target Drudges to practice on, and many more items to have a day out in the fields.

name: Tumerok Tower
desc:
=== Description === A Tower with a few Tumeroks Outpost at 15.6N, 49.9W in the Dires near Fort Tethana, close to the Northern Landbridge.
It is one of the POIs incidated on the Ingame Map. See Points of Interest Map, no. 25.

title: 21.4N, 24.8W - Undead Village
name: Undead Village
desc:
=== Description === A few Gharu type houses with quite a few lower undead housing them.
This is one of the POIs indicated on the Ingame Map. See Points of Interest Map, no. 24.

title: 3.1N, 60.5W - Tumerok Fort
name: Tumerok Fort
desc:
=== Description === A Tumerok Fort at 3.1N, 60.5W in the Dires near Fort Tethana.
It is one of the POIs incidated on the Ingame Map. See Points of Interest Map, no. 27. There is a chest in one of the towers that spawns low tier 3 Loot.

title: 38.1S, 47.3W - Kivik Lir's Temple
name: Kivik Lir's Temple
desc:
=== Description === A Falacatot Temple with loads of Buruns at 38.1S, 47.3W in the Direlands Swamps.
It is one of the POIs indicated on the Ingame Map. See Points of Interest Map, no. 36.

title: 40.0S, 54.9W - Tumerok Stronghold
name: Tumerok Stronghold
desc:
=== Description === A huge double structure with loads of Tumeroks at 40.0S, 54.9W in the East Direlands.
The NE one is an open structure with 3 towers, the SW one is a closed, and locked, walled structure.
One of the towers has a locked chest (difficulty 80) that contains tier 3 Loot, and the other tower has a portal to Dryreach.

title: 45.2S, 83.2W - Tumerok Fort
name: Tumerok Fort
desc:
=== Description === A Renegade Fort in the West Dires near Ayan Baqur.
There is a chest in one of the towers that spawns low tier 4 Loot.
The fort is one of the POIs indicated on the Ingame Map. See Points of Interest Map, no. 38

title: 51.1S, 82.0W - Tumerok Fort
name: Tumerok Fort
desc:
=== Description === A Tumerok Fort in the West Dires near Ayan Baqur. The door is unlocked using the Heavy Tumerok Key and a High Priest in one of the towers drops a key used to unlock the final 12.3N, 73.7W - Tumerok Fort in the Overlord's Sword Quest.
This fort is one of the POIs incidated on the Ingame Map. See Points of Interest Map, no. 39

title: 74.2S, 21.9E - Qalaba'r Festival Grounds
name: Qalaba'r Festival Grounds
desc:
=== Description === One of the Festival Grounds, this one located at 74.2S, 21.9E just a bit E from Qalaba'r.
It has two shopkeepers located in tents, two Chessboards, a few Target Drudges to practice on, and many more items to have a day out in the fields.

desc:
=== Description === A Tumerok Outpost at 9.0N, 65.7W in the Dires near Fort Tethana.
There are some Empyrean Statues nearby that create a trail leading to the bunker.
It is one of the POIs indicated on the Ingame Map. See Points of Interest Map, no. 28.

title: 9.7S, 63.3W - Tumerok Fort
name: Tumerok Fort
desc:
=== Description === A huge fort with loads of Augmented Tumeroks at 9.7S, 63.3W in the Dires near Fort Tethana. Some entrances to the fort have been blocked with Standing Stones and rocks, but the doorways are clear on the south side.
There are two chests in the fort: one outside the walls at 9.9S, 62.8W that is unlocked and spawns tier 3 Loot and another inside the fort with a Sturdy Iron loc

title: Abandoned Observatory
name: Abandoned Observatory
desc: === Description === An Observatory that has been taken over by Shadows, it houses a chest which contains a note with the wheareabouts of part of the Staff of the Nomads. The two pieces of the staff were originally held to the south east at the Tombs of the Sand Kings inside Anadil's Tomb. The tombs were raided by the Shadows stationed here under Black Ferah's instructions.

title: Access to Crystal Mines
name: Access to Crystal Mines
desc: === Description === Six giant platforms suspended in the air, five of which have a portal to each version of the Crystal Mine. The actual platforms are found west of the Mount Esper at 70.5N, 8.1W (see map to the right). === Route ===

title: Advocate Ruins
name: Advocate Ruins
desc: === Description === These ruins were the secret training grounds and headquarters for Strathelar's Order of Advocates. With the disbanding of the order the Advocate Dungeon has been removed, but the ruins and lifestone remain. === Route ===

title: Advocate and Sentinel Monument
name: Advocate and Sentinel Monument
desc:
=== Description === A monument to remember the efforts of Advocates and Sentinels to help new players in the early days of AC.
It is found in the hills just outside of Zaikhal at 4.4N,1.3E, just outside Hebian-To at 40.3S, 84.5E and in Cragstone at 24.3N, 48.6E

name: Aerbax's Citadel
desc: === Description === Aerbax's Citadel high up in the air around 65.0S 63.8W in the center of the Obsidian Plains. It consists of many side platforms around a center. See the quest. === Route ===

title: Aia's Tower
name: Aia's Tower
desc: === Description === Aia's Tower, built by Empyrean architect Saolor Lentain. === Route ===

title: Ancient Lugian Fortress
name: Ancient Lugian Fortress
desc: === Description === An ancient Lugian fortress that is seemingly rising from the sea. It has the same layout as Linvak Tukal. Various Lugian relics are strewn about the city, including the Well-Balanced Lugian Greataxe. At the top of the center tower is a Lugian Lifestone. === Route ===

desc:
=== Description === The home of Asheron on Asheron's Island. Located at 21.1N, 69.3E on top of a huge mountain, with a long spiraling path up.
The castle has been playing a major role during the A Time of Chaos story arc. Since then, the Castle has been accessible on and off during different story arcs.

desc:
=== Description ===
The Blessing of Aerlinthe. A gromnatross makes her aerie on the peaks of Cunara. She is named Aurlanaa by the people of the port.

The rumored nest of a Gromnatross at 89.0N 42.8E on Aerlinthe, overlooking a lava stream. There's a white Empyrean Ruin Meeting Hall Style Building nearby.

title: Bachus Flufens' Cottage
name: Bachus Flufens' Cottage
desc: (Rumor) === Description === The former homestead of Bachus Flufens before she was chased away by Hea Tumeroks. Bachus was carrying out research into rumors of a Tumerok artifact. She has since taken refuge in the nearby town of Redspire where she continues her research.

title: Banderling Castle
name: Banderling Castle
desc:
=== Description === A Castle full of lower level Banderlings at 66.2N, 2.3W. This castle also holds 3 chests down in the bunker, one of them being the Camping Mastery Chest. Some lower level Tumeroks guard the chests.
During the Who Watches the Virindi? event, an Exploration Marker for the Dereth Exploration Quest was added.

title: Banderling Fort
name: Banderling Fort
desc:
=== Description === A fort at 22.5N, 10.5W near Zaikhal, with lots of lower level Banderlings
The fort consists of several round buildings, like that found in the center of Bandit Castle.

title: Battlefield of Ayn Tayan
name: Battlefield of Ayn Tayan
desc: === General Information === This point of interest consists of a small hill populated mostly by low level skeletons (mostly Warriors). At the base of the hill lies a statue of Bael'Zharon surrounded by many bones. Traveling up the hill you will find to carpeted with bones and some Skeletons. At the top of the hill you will find more bones and skeletons as well as a large Empyrean style head with a

title: Black Hill
name: Black Hill
desc:
=== Description === An area located 62.4S, 52.3W on the western edge of the Obsidian Plains near Wai Jhou.
Primarily a waypoint for players wanting to access the Obsidian Plains via a Black Hill Portal, or wanting to access the base of the Plains or Wai Jhou via the Small Black Hill Portal located on Black Hill.

title: Burning Wood
name: Burning Wood
desc: === Description === The Burning Wood is the area of the Graveyard found in the valley to the southwest. During the night time, a unique creature called the Corrupted Pyre Oak sometimes appears in the wood at 66.5S, 44.8W. Lord Hendrel also spawns in this area as part of the Castle of Lord Mhoire Quest.

title: Burun Fortress
name: Burun Fortress
desc: === Description === A huge fortress at 25.8S, 46.3E in the Blackmire Swamp near Yanshi, full of Burun. To the south is a destroyable Fortress Barrier. On the table just outside the Barrier, the Blueprints for a Burun Fortress can be picked up. === Route ===

title: Burun Ruuk Village
name: Burun Ruuk Village
desc: === Description === A village built by the Burun Ruuk shortly after they arrived to Dereth through portals in the Temple of Ixir Zi. The village itself is centered around the temple's entrance. The creatures here drop untranslated texts that are used in the Blackmire Lore quest. === Route ===

title: Camp of the Latzimestal
name: Camp of the Latzimestal
desc:
=== Description === Three tents at 83.0S, 93.2E near Ithaenc Cathedral.
The Camp of the Latzimestal was the gathering point for the Dericost forces, including Anadil, Asmolum the Worm, Rytheran, Aerfalle and Elleina of Berkesh prior to the battle of the undead army against Bael'Zharon in P.Y. 11.2000/08 - Taste of Twilight - Dark Revenant Note Translation 2000/08 - Taste of T

title: Castle Pietrus
name: Castle Pietrus
desc: === Description === Very large Viamontian castle, inside is a villa with a courtyard like one that can be purchased. Inside the villa on the top floor is Captain Vietre Lasallia who drops a Viamontian Pennant (Pietrus Castle). Down the stairs is a small side room full of books and a chest, one of the books is the Castle Pietrus Log Book. === Route ===

title: Castle of Baron Nuvillus
name: Castle of Baron Nuvillus
desc: (Rumors) === Description === An Empyrean castle Northeast of Shoushi ruled by Baron Nuvillus. The Baron drops the Crown of Bone. The Spinning Wheel is located here.

title: Cataracts of Sabella
name: Cataracts of Sabella
desc: === Description === The Cataracts of Sabella are a series of giant waterfalls, located at 82.7N, 74.7W on Lotila Island. The Cataracs are indicated as a POI on the Ingame Map. See Points of Interest Map, no. 02.

name: Caulcano

name: Chalicmere Castle
desc:
=== Description === Mentioned at length in Aerfalle's Letter, Chalicmere is an open fortress in the heart of the Direlands at 17.0S 57.4W.
You can either unlock the front door (Resistance 242) or use the roofs to jump your way over the wall.

title: Chapel Blackspire
